integrity: The claim is supported by a self-contained spanning construction, a direct rational-iterate reduction, and the published 2026 rotation-set lower bound. No numerical experiment is used as proof, and no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact dichotomy is proved only for scalar torus skew products with rational base rotation; irrational base rotations are not classified.
The compact-base velocity-range argument gives \(h_{\mathrm{pol}}\le1\) for scalar twists, but no analogous zero-one classification is asserted for higher-dimensional fibers.

The literature comparison is non-exhaustive. A 2023 published scalar angle-action proposition states a conflicting value; the present proof resolves the displayed scalar model by an explicit spanning bound but does not assess the rest of that paper.
title: A zero-one polynomial entropy law for continuous rational skew products
